static_traits.name: Fang Jie
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友但难以建立深层连接，常感到Loneliness与隔离
static_traits.medical_history: without重大身体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能具体描述经历；入访时感到紧张但配合度较高；Neutral attitude；倾向Self-denial与悲观推断

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己找not到愿意和我在一起的人，所以用养很多狗来补偿陪伴的缺失。这种信念导致我长期感到Loneliness和隔离。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到Loneliness影响了我的心理健康与整体幸福感，我想学习如何与他人建立有意义的连接。
growth_experiences: 几年前经历了一次非常艰难的分手，之后长期感到Loneliness与隔离，自认为without法与他人建立更深层的连接；多次尝试约会与参与社交活动失败使问题逐步加剧，看到情侣或在社交场合时更易triggerLoneliness与despair；为缓解情绪主要通过投入工作与与狗相伴，但情绪仍持续影响工作表现、社交生活与自我照料。

core_beliefs: have not人愿意和我在一起
I am not good enough或not够有趣，without法让人长期留下
我缺少某些do not人拥有的东西（因此注定without法建立亲密关系）

special_situations.event: Sees couples or others paired up at social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not伴侣或深层连接，就说明我有问题、not值得被爱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing曝光，将注意力转向工作与与狗相伴以自我安抚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远找not到愿意和我在一起的人；我缺了点什么

special_situations.event: 回顾多次约会not yet果的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果尝试have not成功，就证明我注定without法建立亲密关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers openness and reduces further attempts to avoid being frustrated again

special_situations.event: 意识到朋友欣赏自己、狗给予without条件的爱时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有与伴侣的亲密连接才算真正的连接，其他积极关系都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or devalues existing positive connections to maintain existing beliefs

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达Loneliness，他们会觉得我在抱怨、not愿意听我说
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids opening up to friends and seeking help, choosing to bear it alone

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to build stable, deep intimate relationships and to be accepted and accompanied
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被negate与再次失败，被他人视为“在抱怨”或“not够好”
defense_goal: 通过保持一定疏离与减少自我暴露来降低Being rejected的风险
以工作与与狗相伴替代人际亲密以Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: 我是Loneliness、并not够好、难以被长期接纳的人
object_relations.object_representation: Others are paired up, people who may criticize or reject me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing couples in social settings or when intimate relationship topics are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fang Jie将他人的亲密状况解读为自己的失败，认为自己“有问题、注定without法建立亲密关系”（移情：自我贬损）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与negate性语言，强调自身not足与失败经历，语气低落、减少眼神接触与细节展开。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当考虑向朋友表达Loneliness感或在咨询中被邀请更开放时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fang Jie倾向认为他人会把自己视为“在抱怨”、not愿Listening（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 礼貌但回避披露，use含糊其辞与Displacement话题的方式，轻描淡写感受、缩短回应长度。

manifestations: Living alone并与4只狗相伴以弥补陪伴缺失
分手后长期感到without法与人建立深层连接
在看到情侣或Attending social activities时强烈感到格格not入与Loneliness
Has a few friends but finds it hard to open up to them
outcomes: Social avoidance，难以建立亲密关系
Work performance affected，社交生活与自我照料受损

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believes friends will see them as complaining, thus avoids opening up
Presetting others' negative views of oneself before social interactions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: not向朋友表达Loneliness与需求，选择独自承受
通过投入工作与与狗相伴来Displacement与自我安抚而非寻求人类支持

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Self-denial（如“I am not good enough/not够有趣”）导致Social withdrawal
Excessively cares about others' opinions in social settings, thus reducing self-exposure and interaction

positive_force: Love for dogs bringing stable emotional support and potential social cues
仍保持几位朋友的支持与欣赏
Willing to seek help and try new perspectives and behavioral experiments
在摄影工作中具备投入与创造力
negative_force: 过度概括、心理过滤与negate积极面的认知歪曲
害怕Being rejected，难以向朋友敞开与表达需求
Low sense of self-worth、倾向自责与despair
Social avoidance，看到情侣时trigger强烈without望感

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance与难以向他人敞开
antecedent: 看到情侣或Attending social activities时感到格格not入
target_behavior.core_reason: 分手后形成“have not人愿意和我在一起/I am not good enough”的信念与Being rejected恐惧，并伴随过度概括、心理过滤与negate积极面的认知歪曲。
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与被评价的可能，维持短期安全感与情绪稳定
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness与隔离持续，深层关系难以建立，工作、社交与自我照料受影响

target_behavior.behavior: 消极自我对话与despair感（如“我永远找not到伴侣”“I am not good enough”）
antecedent: Being alone时Reflection过往失败的关系
在社交场合看到他人成双成对时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将过去失败经历泛化为“我注定找not到伴侣”，并对他人想法进行负面读心，形成稳定的负性核心信念。
target_behavior.function: 通过自我贬低来降低期望以预防挫败，暂时减少Anxiety与not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与Decreased drive，进一步Reduced socializing与求偶尝试，问题循环加重
